headline: Dangote Cement 9-Month Pre-Tax Profit Climbs 41% to N1.47 Trillion
summary: Dangote Cement grew nine-month revenue by 20% to N3.77 trillion, while pre-tax profit surged 41% to N1.47 trillion across its operations.
why: Dangote Cement is Nigeria's largest listed company by market capitalization and the dominant building-materials producer across Sub-Saharan Africa.

impacts.name: Dangote Cement Plc
impacts.why: Nine-month pre-tax profit rose 41% alongside a 20% top-line revenue expansion.
